<translate>
<!--T:4-->
'''Gete tech''' is the rare alien metal tied to the [[Special:MyLanguage/Big Gete Star|Big Gete Star]] and the Metal Cooler machinery. Its materials go into the Gete tools, the [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Battery|Ki Battery]] and the Gete [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|Capsules]], and Bulma builds several upgrades from them.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gete tools == <!--T:18-->

<!--T:19-->
The '''Gete Pickaxe''', '''Gete Axe''', '''Gete Shovel''' and '''Gete Hoe''' are made at '''Dr. Kikono's Station''' from the Gete Pattern, Gete Ingots and [[Special:MyLanguage/Kikono Materials|Kikono Sticks]], using the matching '''netherite''' tool as the template. Each costs 1,000 Star Energy (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Armor#Assembling the armor|Armor]]).

<!--T:20-->
They are more durable than netherite tools (3,250 uses), mine faster and are repaired with Gete Ingots.
</translate>
{{Recipe|gete_pickaxe|gete_axe|gete_shovel|gete_hoe}}

<translate>
== Bulma's Gete sidequests == <!--T:21-->

<!--T:22-->
* '''Metal from the Big Star:''' bring her 3 Gete Scrap for 2 Gete Ingots.
* '''Gete Forge:''' rewards the Gete Pattern.
* '''Gete Enhancements:''' rewards an enchanted book with the Gete-tech enchantments '''Ki Conductivity''' and '''Gravity Forged''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Enchantments|Enchantments]]).
* '''Capsule Tech:''' rewards a Red and an Orange Gete Capsule.
</translate>

<translate>
== Other uses == <!--T:23-->

<!--T:24-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Ki Battery|Ki Battery]]: one Gete Ingot each.
* Gete Capsules: any capsule + a Gete Ingot (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Capsules|Capsules]]).
</translate>
